_comment: Printed symbol -> plaintext. grade S: fixed by cryptanalysis (README: method and controls); C: read from Birch's 1653 glosses; I: inferred; M: unread. 'from' names the words or glosses that fix the value. Printer's errors are in repairs.json.

7.from: most frequent symbol; een, eenige, doen, bewaren

57.from: once, P500.1: in [57]n viandich land needs een, as P431.1 segghe [77]n. A homophone of 77 or a misprint for it; either way ee

617.from: once, P522.1: Birch's gloss 'the good dispositions' over [617] goede dispositie; the article (de or die)

115.from: once, P582.2: Birch's gloss 'ten ships at Yarmouth were run away' over thien schepen to [115] geloopen, with 'to' (tot) in clear; the place-name code. Spelling supplied

77.from: gequalifi(c)eert (P522.3), een cijffer (P431.1); reads ee. An intentional digraph and joined 7.7 are both possible; the print alone does not decide.

71.from: once, P522.3 in 'propositi-?'; not a key symbol, see repairs.json

1.from: once, P582.2 at a line end after 'geloope'; not a key symbol, see repairs.json

109.from: Birch p.523, 10 October 1653 NS: contemporary English gloss; original Dutch wording not recovered.
